title: OpenPak content decodes on your console
body: Your console can now read what we write. On 9 September a patched Switch downloaded our signed, encrypted News catalog through the console's own downloader and decoded it successfully, the first time OpenPak-authored content cleared native signature and decryption checks end to end. Earlier the same week, an article posted locally rendered fully in the News app, text and images included. Server-delivered articles are the next step: the channel page, subscriptions and automatic delivery are being validated right now.
footer: OpenPak — open network services for your console.
